f3.evidence: The F3 doppelganger pattern is UNCHANGED by hybrid retrieval on this evidence. (1) Doppelganger SOURCES are provider-side and unchanged: 3 of 4 are byte-identical to run-002's source lists (02 Mike Berners-Lee, 03 singer+album, 08 The Wall – Live in Berlin) and the 4th (04) changed identity by provider variance (NRW state → Westphalia region), not by hybrid. (2) Union retrieval relevance is unchanged at 0.6875 with the 0.5s in exactly the four doppelganger cases. (3) Hybrid DID re-rank stored passages: the dominant answer blocks are on-topic for all four cases (02: 4/5, 03: 5/6, 04: 6/6, 08: 4/5) and the direct-answer passages lead cases 04 and 08 — but doppelganger passages still occupy answer blocks (02 bio, 03 singles, 08 Waters quote), so they still compete, and cross-question keyword noise persists under RRF (case-05 Berners-Lee bibliography on 'How', case-07 partitioning stub + Aurora tour on 'what'/'What', case-06 four 'Earth'-matched blocks aggravated by the sparse pool after 5 fetchErrors). (4) Honest framing: hybrid affects which STORED passages feed the answer (RRF ranking); the search-hit selection itself is provider-side and unchanged — doppelganger SOURCES may still be fetched and stored, so retrieval relevance scores reflect the union. A scoring mechanism that re-ranks cannot unstore what the provider returns; lifting F3 requires provider-side hit quality or a doppelganger-aware storage/filter policy, which this run did not test.

findings: F3 (retrieval, re-measured under hybrid): UNCHANGED — see comparison.f3 for the full evidence chain. Hybrid RRF is live and mechanically verified (embedded == passagesStored, 317/317) but did not lift the doppelganger pattern: sources are provider-side, the union scores are unmoved, and cross-question keyword noise survives in answers (05, 06, 07).

F8 (rate limiting, new): one hard 429 (case-07 research attempt-1) and 5 soft fetch errors in one window (case-06, fetches 1/6) — the politeness envelope behaved correctly both times (error event surfaced, Retry-After honored, no hot retry); a 60s pause + single retry recovered case-07 fully; case-06 was left honestly degraded (no re-ask; its research call completed with a truthful fetchErrors tally). Suggested future improvement: a run-level pacing/backoff policy between research calls so a QUAL pass doesn't straddle a rate-limit window.

F9 (empty-store honesty, new): when research yields nothing case-relevant (case-07 attempt-1 after the 429), the answer surface still claims grounded output (degraded:false, evidenceOnly:false) and composes blocks from cross-question residue in the pooled store — citations resolve, but nothing bears on the question and no evidenceOnly/degraded signal fires. Recorded for the live-model future: with a real LLM this becomes an off-pool answering surface.
F1 (holds): the run-001 template-JSON leak remains fixed under embed-on-store — zero markup/JSON markers across all 18 files this run; SRC-07 + fastembed storage do not reintroduce it.

F2 (noise, unchanged class): stored passages still carry MediaWiki section headings and occasional list/bibliography/caption passages — readable but visible; a heading-dropping pre-pass remains the path toward 1.0.

F6 (limits): citation-resolution and degradation-honesty are 1.0 under the FIXTURE model, which composes blocks from stored evidence — these measure the harness, not model quality; answer fluency/completeness unmeasured (docs/quality-gate.md limits).
